How to get it :
- Crafting table : 3 x Radium-226 Nugget, 3 x [[gv:nugget_beryllium|Beryllium Nugget]].
- Crafting table (x2) : [[Radium-226|Radium-226 Billet]], [[gv:billet_beryllium|Beryllium Billet]].
- Crafting table (x6) : 3 x [[Radium-226|Radium-226 Billet]], 3 x [[gv:billet_beryllium|Beryllium Billet]].

Used to make :
[[gv:pile_rod_mk2_ra226be|Chicago Pile Ra226Be Neutron source]], [[gv:pwr_neutron_source|PWR Neutron Source]], [[gv:rbmk_fuel_ra226be|Ra226Be RBMK Neutron Source]].
